messages:
anya: Follow-up thread for the recent vendor auth + registry outage. We need to lock owners and dates for remediation and set up recurring tracking. Postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-dep-outage
selina: Summary: vendor enforced unexpected token-exchange throttling; our registry was single-region and lost route during a cloud networking event. Compound failure.
dmitri: Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) add auth circuit breaker + jittered backoff, 2) implement local manifest cache fallback, 3) quick cross-region read-only replicas.
infra-bot: Cloud provider maintenance log shows transient route flaps in region. Recommend cross-region replication to mitigate single-region risk.
ops-squad: Need owners and due dates. I'll track in ticket DEP-840.
anya: Owners I'm proposing:
- DEP-A: Circuit breaker & telemetry around token exchange (owner: dmitri) due: 2026-03-30
- DEP-B: Local manifest cache w/ 5m TTL + session refresh flag (owner: selina) due: 2026-03-28
- DEP-C: Regional replicas + fallback routing (owner: infra) due: 2026-04-08
- DEP-D: Vendor SLA/quotas review + written request for burst headroom (owner: selina) due: 2026-03-25
- DEP-E: Runbook updates & auth-failure canary test (owner: anya) due: 2026-03-29
ops-squad: Created DEP-840 and linked to postmortem. Please include ticket IDs in PR descriptions.
dmitri: For DEP-A I'll add metrics for failed status codes and a dashboard tile.
selina: For DEP-B TTL 5m seems reasonable. We'll add a safety that forbids using cache for config that is older than 10m for new model sessions.
infra-bot: Note: cross-region replication requires an infra change window and schema compatibility review. Submit RFC by 2026-03-27.
product-lead: Any UX-visible change (latency or stale models) needs comms and SLO note. Keep product in the loop.
anya: I'll set a recurring 30-day dependency-resilience review and rotate ownership: selina -> dmitri -> infra.
ops-squad: Added alert rule: auth-exchange-fail-rate >0.5% for 5m -> auto-open incident channel. Owner: eng-ops.
selina: Vendor meeting scheduled for 2026-03-24. I'll request quota increase and ask for written burst-handling guidance.
dmitri: :thumbsup: starting BRB PR for circuit breaker. Will link DEP-840.
selina: :thumbsup: adding cache PR draft.
anya: Please react with :thumbsup: to accept. I'll update the postmortem action table after confirmation.
dmitri: :thumbsup: accepted.
selina: :thumbsup: accepted.
infra-bot: DEP-840 updated: 5 open actions, 3 owners assigned.
anya: Next sync 2026-03-31 09:00 UTC. Keep updates in DEP-840. Ping here if blocked.
